reader_summary.headline: David Zorub is the Founder and CIO of Parsifal Capital Management.
reader_summary.overview: David Zorub is the Founder and CIO of Parsifal Capital Management. David joined me on the show a few months before he launched Parsifal six years ago to discuss his plans. We got back together to talk about what's happened since.

key_points.text: David Zorub is the Founder and CIO of Parsifal Capital Management.
Our conversation covers the headwinds facing fundamental investing, Parsifal's approach to counter those challenges.
Along the way, David shares keen insights into research, portfolio construction.
